briefing: Markets sold off sharply today with NASDAQ down 3.3% and the S&P 500 down 2.0%, a clear risk-off day. No new candidates were screened, so I'm holding all 7 existing positions and keeping cash in reserve rather than forcing a trade.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' day is when investors broadly pull back from riskier assets like growth stocks and tech, often moving into cash or safer holdings, usually without one single clear cause. The right response as a long-term investor is often to avoid chasing new trades and let existing positions ride out the volatility.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險規避」(Risk-Off)日是指投資者普遍減少對高風險資產(如成長股及科技股)的持有,轉而持有現金或較安全的資產,通常並非由單一明確原因引發。作為長期投資者,較正確的應對方式通常是避免追逐新交易,讓現有持倉自然度過這段波動期。

market_education.summary_en: Broad-based selling hit growth and tech-heavy names hardest today, dragging the NASDAQ down more than the S&P 500. On days like this, risk appetite fades quickly and investors rotate out of higher-beta positions into cash or defensive assets. No specific news catalysts were provided for today's session, so this move looks like a broad risk-off repricing rather than a single-stock event.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日市場出現大範圍拋售,科技股及高增長股票受創最深,導致納斯達克指數跌幅超過標普500指數。這類日子裡,市場風險偏好會迅速降溫,投資者傾向將資金從高波動性持倉轉移至現金或防禦性資產。由於今日未提供具體新聞觸發因素,這次下跌更像是整體性的風險規避重新定價,而非單一股票事件所致。
